title: VerificationResult and SignerResult missing PartialEq
description: verify.rs: VerificationResult and SignerResult derive Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize but not PartialEq/Eq. Callers writing integration tests must manually compare fields rather than using assert_eq\!. The only reason to omit PartialEq is if a field type doesn't support it, but all fields (bool, Option<String>, Vec<SignerResult>) do. Add #[derive(PartialEq, Eq)] to both types.
